name: Sunny Acres
css:
/* Sunny Acres: a cozy 16-bit farm (original pixel illustration). Wooden fence sidebar, parchment dialog-box threads and messages with hard pixel borders, a stamina bar over the composer that drains as the context fills and blinks while the agent works. Square corners throughout. Light only. */
 :root{--t3-radius-composer: 0;--t3-radius-bubble: 0;--t3-radius-card: 0;--t3-radius-control: 0;--t3-composer-outline: transparent;--sa-wood: #8a5a2b;--sa-dark: #3d2412;--sa-parch: #fbefcf;--sa-gold: #f2c14e;--sa-green: #5bb043;--sa-pixel: "Silom","Monaco",ui-monospace,monospace;--sa-box: inset 0 0 0 3px var(--sa-dark),inset 0 0 0 5px #fffaf0,inset 0 -8px 0 0 rgb(160 110 50 / 0.18)}[data-t3-part="app-shell"]{accent-color: var(--sa-green);image-rendering: pixelated;background: var(--t3-asset-art) 100% 100% / cover no-repeat,#8fd0f5}[data-t3-part="main"]{--app-theme-canvas: transparent}[data-t3-part="sidebar"]{--app-theme-sidebar: transparent;background: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0 46px,rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18) 46px 48px),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05) 0 2px,transparent 2px 64px),linear-gradient(90deg,#9b6633,#8a5a2b 50%,#7a4e24);border-right: 1px solid var(--sa-dark);box-shadow: inset -3px 0 0 #5e3a1a}.sidebar-stage-backdrop{display: none}[data-t3-part="sidebar-header"]{background: var(--sa-dark)}[data-t3-part="sidebar-header"] a>span,[data-t3-part="sidebar-header"] button{color: var(--sa-gold) !important}[data-t3-part="sidebar-header"] a>span>span{font: 17px/1 var(--sa-pixel);letter-spacing: 0.04em;color: var(--sa-gold)}[data-t3-part="sidebar-search"]{background: var(--sa-parch);box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--sa-dark)}[data-t3-part="sidebar-search"] input{font-family: var(--sa-pixel);font-size: 12px;color: var(--sa-dark)}[data-t3-part="sidebar-search"] input::placeholder{color: #8a6a40;opacity: 1}[data-t3-part="sidebar-search"] svg{color: var(--sa-dark)}[data-t3-part="sidebar-toolbar"] button{color: var(--sa-parch);background: rgb(61 36 18 / 0.75)}[data-t3-part="sidebar-toolbar"] button:hover{background: var(--sa-dark)}[data-t3-part="thread-item"]{padding-block: 5px}[data-t3-part="thread-row"]{background: var(--sa-parch);box-shadow: var(--sa-box)}[data-t3-part="thread-row"]:hover{background: #fff6dc}[data-t3-part="thread-row"][data-t3-variant="card"] [data-t3-part="thread-body"]{height: auto;padding-block: 10px}[data-t3-part="thread-title"]{white-space: normal;overflow: visible;text-overflow: clip;font: 13px/1.35 var(--sa-pixel);color: var(--sa-dark)}[data-t3-part="project-name"]{font: 11px var(--sa-pixel);color: #a2491f}[data-t3-part="thread-status"],[data-t3-part="thread-meta"],[data-t3-part="thread-status"] *,[data-t3-part="thread-meta"] *{color: #8a6a40}[data-t3-part="thread-row"][aria-current="page"]{background: linear-gradient(180deg,#ffe08a,var(--sa-gold))}[data-t3-part="thread-row"][aria-current="page"] [data-t3-part="thread-status"] *,[data-t3-part="thread-row"][aria-current="page"] [data-t3-part="thread-meta"] *{color: #6b4518}[data-t3-part="thread-row"][data-t3-agent="waiting"]{outline: 3px dashed #d6402b;outline-offset: 3px}[data-t3-part="sidebar-section-header"],[data-t3-part="sidebar-section-header"] *{font-family: var(--sa-pixel);color: var(--sa-parch) !important}[data-t3-part="sidebar-footer"]{background: var(--sa-dark)}[data-t3-part="sidebar-footer"] button{color: var(--sa-gold)}[data-t3-part="chat-header"]{background: var(--sa-dark);box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #5e3a1a}[data-t3-part="chat-header"] nav li:last-child h2 span{font: 15px/1.2 var(--sa-pixel);color: var(--sa-gold)}[data-t3-part="chat-header"] button,[data-t3-part="chat-header"] nav span{color: var(--sa-parch)}[data-t3-part="user-message-bubble"]{background: #fffdf5;color: var(--sa-dark);border: 0;box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px var(--sa-dark),inset 0 -6px 0 0 rgb(61 36 18 / 0.12),6px 6px 0 rgb(61 36 18 / 0.3)}[data-t3-part="user-message-bubble"] *{color: inherit}[data-t3-part="assistant-message"]:has(.chat-markdown){background: var(--sa-parch);padding: 18px 22px 10px;box-shadow: var(--sa-box),6px 6px 0 rgb(61 36 18 / 0.3);color: var(--sa-dark)}[data-t3-part="assistant-message"] :not(pre)>code{background: #f3dfa6;border-color: #c9a45a;color: #7a3b12}[data-t3-part="code-block"]{box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #c9a45a}[data-t3-part="composer-surface"]{position: relative;background: var(--sa-parch);box-shadow: var(--sa-box),6px 6px 0 rgb(61 36 18 / 0.3)}[data-t3-part="composer-surface"]::before{content: "";position: absolute;z-index: 21;top: -5px;right: 22px;width: 132px;height: 10px;background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 10px,var(--sa-dark) 10px 12px),linear-gradient(90deg,var(--sa-green),#9be05a);box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--sa-dark);clip-path: inset(-2px calc(var(--t3-context-used,0) * 100%) -2px -2px);pointer-events: none}[data-t3-part="composer-input"]{font-family: var(--sa-pixel);font-size: 13px}[data-t3-part="composer-context"]{background: #f1dfb3;box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--sa-dark)}[data-t3-part="composer-toolbar"] button[aria-label="Submit message"]{background: var(--sa-green);color: #fff;box-shadow: inset -2px -2px 0 #2f7a24,inset 2px 2px 0 #9be05a}[data-t3-part="right-panel"],[data-t3-part="terminal-drawer"]{border-color: var(--sa-dark)}[data-t3-part="sidebar-content"],[data-t3-part="transcript"]{scrollbar-color: var(--sa-dark) transparent}@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference){[data-t3-part="chat"][data-t3-agent="working"] [data-t3-part="composer-surface"]::before{animation: sa-blink 0.8s steps(2,jump-none) infinite}[data-t3-part="thread-row"][data-t3-agent="working"]{animation: sa-blink 0.8s steps(2,jump-none) infinite}}@keyframes sa-blink{50%{opacity: 0.55}}[data-t3-part="chat"] h1,[data-t3-part="chat"] h1 ~ *{text-shadow: 0 0 3px #fbefcf,0 0 3px #fbefcf,0 0 10px #fbefcf,0 0 20px #fbefcf}[data-t3-part="chat"] h1 ~ *,[data-t3-part="chat"] h1 ~ * *{color: #3d2412}
